name: backdrops
description: Mica, acrylic and the drag region, which need the system backdrop types.

NoSystemBackdrop.comment: Takes the system backdrop off the window: `noSystemBackdrop = true`. A wrapper is never empty, so there is no empty backdrop to give systemBackdrop; false leaves the window as it is.

MicaController.comment: The Mica controller of this window: the window becomes its target. The controller still needs its configuration, and Close when the window closes.

DesktopAcrylicController.comment: The desktop acrylic controller of this window, the same way.

IsDragRegion.comment: Whether an element in a TitleBar drags the window (true), takes clicks (false) or leaves the choice to the TitleBar (empty) -- TitleBar.IsDragRegion, the attached property.
